findings.finding: The recovery gate counts every offered-but-not-completed request across both GPUs, including naturally in-service work. GPU1 alone sustained 7.5 rps with 1.1359 to 1.1714 seconds mean completion latency, implying approximately 8.50 to 8.79 natural in-flight requests. The configured aggregate recovery threshold of four is therefore impossible at 15 rps.
findings.required_fix: Use reviewed low-backlog semantics or a reviewed threshold above the measured steady-state in-flight floor while retaining sustained negative queue slope, completed service greater than offered, and the full five-second SLO window.

findings.finding: The depth-64 hard safety abort is disabled immediately after the first useful GPU1 request because _enforce_pre_gpu1_queue_abort only raises while gpu1_first_useful is absent.
findings.required_fix: Keep the hard backlog ceiling active throughout two-GPU recovery and fail safely if the bounded backlog is exceeded.

findings.finding: The impossible recovery prolonged v6 while cumulative GPU1 telemetry grew to 1,091,744 bytes and 734 request rows. GPU0 globs, reads, and reparses the latest cumulative snapshot on every engine-step iteration; local parsing of the final snapshot averaged 4.68 ms. This is a measured-path controller feedback mechanism consistent with the observed late GPU0 service-rate decay.
findings.required_fix: Cache or incrementally consume each GPU1 telemetry snapshot so unchanged cumulative JSON is never synchronously reparsed on each GPU0 engine step; cover the behavior with a deterministic replay test.

findings.finding: GPU1 continued reconstructing scheduled work briefly after the serving producer failed, so post-failure GPU1 completions cannot be treated as globally offered traffic.
findings.required_fix: Ensure abort/failure propagation prevents post-producer admissions or explicitly excludes them from all diagnostic service accounting.

compilation_implication.scientific_result: v6 remains invalid; the serving-only clean observation cannot substitute for complete two-engine evidence

retry_budget_if_all_fixes_pass.condition: Budget recommendation is conditional on all high-severity controller fixes, focused replay tests, make check, a clean committed paid path, refreshed phase-budget snapshot, fresh three-review authorization seal, unique v7 config, and a final zero-reservation read-only preflight.
